suites.rationale: Red 1 of 4. The case expects a fact to pass the governed gate with requireAgentReady:false; the gate blocks it as not a canonical tenant key. Probed on the base, three other registry-declared keys are blocked the same way, because src/lib/governance/context-corpus-policy.ts builds isCanonicalClientKey on the short CANONICAL_TENANT_KEYS from src/config/tenants/CANONICAL_TENANTS.ts. That is item 51's open decision (the dual export), the same cause that holds src/lib/programs/learning-writeback/__tests__ under C-415. Not repaired here: changing the fixture's key or widening the list would each settle that decision by the back door.
